# Release Evidence Workflow

Status: P1-18 draft.

## Purpose

This workflow defines local engineering evidence collection for anocrypto-c development builds. It is not official validation evidence and should be reviewed before external sharing.

## Current evidence target

```sh
cmake --build build --target ano_crypto_collect_release_evidence
```

Default output path:

```text
build/evidence/p1-18/
```

## Expected generated files

```text
BUILD_METADATA.txt
SOURCE_FILES.sha256
SOURCE_ARCHIVE_CONTENTS.txt
SOURCE_ARCHIVE.sha256
SOURCE_ARCHIVE.log
anocrypto-c-source.tar.gz
BINARY_FILES.sha256
PUBLIC_SURFACE_CHECK.txt
THREAD_SAFETY_CHECK.txt
SHA2_SCOPE_CHECK.txt
RANDOM_BOUNDARY_CHECK.txt
RANDOM_BOUNDARY_REVIEW_NOTES.txt
ENTROPY_HEALTH_CHECK.txt
ENTROPY_HEALTH_REVIEW_NOTES.txt
REPRODUCIBLE_BUILD_NOTES.txt
SCOPE_REVIEW_NOTES.txt
SBOM_STATUS.txt
SIGNING_STATUS.txt
EVIDENCE_MANIFEST_README.txt
EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.sha256
ctest.log
INSTALL_SMOKE_INSTALL.log
INSTALL_SMOKE_CONFIGURE.log
INSTALL_SMOKE_BUILD.log
INSTALL_SMOKE_RUN.log
INSTALL_SMOKE_SUMMARY.txt
POC_PACKAGE_SMOKE.log
poc-package-smoke/
README.md
```

## Review checklist before sharing

- Confirm the source archive excludes build outputs, generated evidence bundles, local caches, and copied third-party material.
- Confirm logs do not include entropy bytes, DRBG seed material, generated random bytes, MAC output, key material, private keys, tokens, customer data, or internal deployment details.
- Confirm KAT vector provenance is recorded in `cleanroom/SOURCE_MANIFEST.md`.
- Confirm excluded categories are recorded in `cleanroom/EXCLUSION_LOG.md`.
- Confirm claims remain limited to engineering correctness and readiness preparation.
- Confirm platform provider logs include provider name/status only.
- Confirm PoC package manifests and logs do not disclose local customer/internal details before sharing.
- Confirm P1-12 scope-review notes still match the intended customer and validation-target candidate boundary.
- Confirm P1-13 SBOM/signing placeholder status and evidence manifest are accurate.
- Confirm P1-14 thread-safety support matrix and CI checklist match the current build configuration.
- Confirm P1-15 SHA-384/SHA-512 reserved scope records remain accurate.
- Confirm P1-16 random-service boundary notes match `ac_random.h` and do not imply implemented public random generation.
- Confirm P1-17 entropy hook is disabled outside the dedicated failure lane and is absent from the clean PoC SDK.
- Confirm P1-17 health-test records remain engineering skeleton evidence and contain no entropy, seed, generated bytes, or DRBG state.

## Known gaps

- No complete SBOM generation yet; P1-13 records placeholder status only.
- No release signing evidence yet; P1-13 records placeholder status only.
- CI workflow has not yet been reviewed against all customer toolchains.
- Windows-specific concurrent CSP/HMAC coverage remains TODO.
- Sanitizer lanes remain TODO until compiler/toolchain policy is selected.
- PoC package legal/evaluation notice remains TODO pending legal review.
- Source archive timestamp normalization is still TODO if byte-for-byte archives become required.
- Binary reproducibility across hosts/toolchains is still TODO.
- No official validation evidence.
- Public random-service API review record exists as a P1-16 reserved-boundary decision; implementation remains TODO.
- No selected block cipher/mode implementation scope yet.
- No differential-reference tool/source has been selected yet.

## P1-17 additions

- Dedicated entropy failure-injection option and Linux CI lane added; ordinary/evidence/PoC SDK builds keep the hook off.
- Internal bounded startup/continuous duplicate-block health-test candidates added for testability and state-transition review.
- Negative tests cover source failure, partial output, zero length, oversized requests, fatal health failure, DRBG invalidation, and sticky module error state.
- Entropy/health policy check added: `tools/check_entropy_health_policy.cmake`.
- Evidence collection writes `ENTROPY_HEALTH_CHECK.txt` and `ENTROPY_HEALTH_REVIEW_NOTES.txt`.
- PoC staging performs a separate clean shared-library build and writes `ENTROPY_HEALTH_PACKAGE_NOTES.txt`.
- Actual entropy samples, seed material, DRBG state, and generated bytes are excluded from evidence.

## P1-18 additions

The default evidence target additionally creates:

- `ENTROPY_OPERATIONAL_POLICY_CHECK.txt`
- `ENTROPY_OPERATIONAL_REVIEW_NOTES.txt`

Review these with `ENTROPY_HEALTH_CHECK.txt` and `ENTROPY_HEALTH_REVIEW_NOTES.txt`. Confirm OS-provider classification, health-test ownership, operational-probe status, process-change reseed behavior, and public-random reservation. The records must not contain provider output, entropy/seed material, nonce material, DRBG state, or generated random output.
